name: LFunction_changeLevel_aux
statement: ℕ} [NeZero M] [NeZero N] (hMN : M ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) {s : ℂ} (hs : s ≠ 1) : LFunction (changeLevel hMN χ) s = LFunction χ s * ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, (1 - χ p * p ^ (-s))

name: LFunction_changeLevel
statement: ℕ} [NeZero M] [NeZero N] (hMN : M ∣ N) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ M) {s : ℂ} (h : χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) : LFunction (changeLevel hMN χ) s = LFunction χ s * ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, (1 - χ p * p ^ (-s))
